articles.title: Expert Q&A: The Intersection of 340B Discounts and PBM Rebates
articles.summary: An expert Q&A with Jeff Dunn explores the complex dynamics between 340B drug discounts and PBM rebate structures. This discussion touches on core cost-management and pricing transparency issues that directly impact self-funded employers and PBM strategy.
articles.source_line: Source: Managed Healthcare Executive; Tue, 17 Nov 2026 13:19:34 GMT

articles.title: DOL PBM Disclosure Rule Exposes Pharmacy Clawbacks for Self-Funded Plans
articles.summary: The Department of Labor's new PBM disclosure rule increases scrutiny on pharmacy clawbacks and spread pricing within employer-sponsored health plans. Self-funded plan sponsors and PBMs must prepare for heightened transparency requirements regarding indirect compensation and fees. This regulatory shift empowers employers to demand greater accountability over hidden PBM revenue streams.
articles.source_line: Source: Pharmacy Times; Tue, 17 Nov 2026 22:39:35 GMT

articles.title: State Prior Authorization Regulations Create Compliance Patchwork for Employers
articles.summary: State insurance regulators are increasingly implementing divergent prior authorization rules, creating a complex regulatory patchwork that complicates benefit administration for self-funded employers. While self-funded plans typically fall under ERISA preemption, these varying state-level mandates increase administrative friction and compliance challenges for multi-state employers managing pharmacy and medical benefits. This fragmented landscape impacts how PBMs and plan sponsors design consistent utilization management strategies across state lines.

articles.title: DOL Finalizes New PBM Transparency Rule Impacting Self-Funded Employers
articles.summary: The Department of Labor has finalized a new pharmacy benefit manager transparency rule under ERISA, placing additional fiduciary compliance burdens on plan sponsors. This regulation directly impacts self-funded employers by requiring greater disclosure of PBM compensation and pricing practices. Plan sponsors must review their existing PBM contracts to ensure alignment with these new reporting standards and fiduciary requirements.
articles.source_line: Source: Drug Topics; Tue, 17 Nov 2026 15:06:48 GMT

articles.title: Judiciary Committee Witnesses Urge Congressional Action on PBM Transparency and Drug Cost Legislation
articles.summary: Congressional witnesses at a Judiciary Committee hearing pushed for the passage of Grassley-backed bills aimed at increasing transparency and accountability for pharmacy benefit managers. For self-funded employers and PBMs, this highlights continued federal momentum toward legislative reform of PBM business practices and drug pricing mechanisms.

articles.title: State PBM Laws Face ERISA Preemption Challenges in Court
articles.summary: State-level pharmacy benefit manager regulations are increasingly colliding with ERISA preemption challenges in court. This legal battle directly impacts self-funded employer health plans by threatening state efforts to enforce PBM transparency, spread pricing bans, and rebate passing. The outcome will determine whether self-funded plans can rely on state-level consumer protections or remain exclusively governed by federal ERISA rules.
articles.source_line: Source: Word & Brown General Agency; Tue, 17 Nov 2026 19:55:26 GMT

articles.title: High-Cost Specialty Prescriptions Threaten Self-Funded Employer Benefit Budgets
articles.summary: SHARx warns employers that a single high-cost specialty prescription can severely disrupt an organization's annual health benefits budget. The alert underscores the escalating financial risk self-funded employers face regarding specialty drug expenditures and the critical need for advanced cost-containment strategies.
articles.source_line: Source: Yahoo Finance; Tue, 17 Nov 2026 13:05:00 GMT

articles.title: Hospital Sues Payer Over Specialty Pharmacy Prescription Steering Practices
articles.summary: A hospital system has filed a lawsuit against Highmark challenging its specialty prescription steering practices, which direct patients toward preferred pharmacies. This legal action highlights ongoing market tensions surrounding channel management and network exclusivity in specialty pharmacy. For self-funded employers, such disputes underscore the complexities of specialty drug distribution and the ongoing scrutiny facing payer and PBM network designs.

articles.title: Employer Health Benefit Costs Exceeding Projections
articles.summary: Rising healthcare and pharmacy benefit costs are outpacing initial employer projections, putting increased financial pressure on self-funded health plans. This escalating cost crunch highlights the urgent need for employers to adopt aggressive PBM strategies and cost containment measures.
articles.source_line: Source: Word & Brown General Agency; Tue, 17 Nov 2026 19:54:38 GMT

articles.title: Employer Strategies for Managing GLP-1 Coverage Costs Without Budget Strain
articles.summary: This article explores how self-funded employers are successfully managing the soaring costs of GLP-1 obesity and diabetes medications while maintaining employee coverage. It highlights practical cost-containment strategies, plan design adjustments, and benefit management approaches critical for self-funded health plans facing specialty drug inflation.
articles.source_line: Source: Insurance Business; Tue, 17 Nov 2026 12:05:49 GMT

articles.title: Fragmented Market Incentives Impede US Biosimilar Adoption and Access
articles.summary: A new report highlights how fragmented financial incentives across the healthcare supply chain continue to hinder widespread US biosimilar adoption and patient access. For self-funded employers and PBMs, overcoming these structural barriers is critical to unlocking substantial specialty drug cost savings. The findings emphasize the need for plan designs and PBM strategies that actively align incentives to favor lower-cost biosimilars.
articles.source_line: Source: Center for Biosimilars; Tue, 17 Nov 2026 18:42:37 GMT

articles.title: Teladoc Introduces Partial Employer Contribution Model for GLP-1 Coverage
articles.summary: Teladoc Health has launched a new weight care program allowing self-funded employers to set partial financial contributions for GLP-1 medications. This development provides employers with greater cost-sharing flexibility to manage the surging expenses of obesity drugs within their benefits plans. As GLP-1 utilization remains a critical cost driver for self-funded plans, alternative coverage and copay structure innovations are of high strategic interest.
articles.source_line: Source: Fierce Healthcare; Tue, 17 Nov 2026 22:12:28 GMT
